user_input: Write a love poem from a female goomba that loves Mario but is forced to fight him anyway.
model_output:
Oh Mario, my heart beats for thee
But alas, our love must be set free
For I am a Goomba, and my fate is clear
To fight against the one I love the most, with fear

I watch as you leap and jump with grace,
With every step, my heart does race.
But as the battle starts, I must take a stand,
And fight against the one I love, with a heavy hand.

Oh Mario, I wish our love was true,
And we could dance the night away, in a love so new.
But alas, our fate is not to be,
And I must fight against my love, until the day I see.

So let us fight, my love, until the end,
And maybe one day, our love will descend,
And we will dance and sing, in joy and glee,
Until our love is free, and our hearts leap with glee.
